title: Monitoring the evolution of antisemitic discourse on extremist social media using BERT
benchmark_measurement: Detection and thematic clustering of antisemitic tropes, including those with a religious basis such as the deicide charge ('Jews Killed Jesus Christ') and references to rabbinical tradition.
findings: The proposed methodology successfully identified a distinct cluster of antisemitic posts (labeled C5: Religion) centered on religious themes. This cluster included terms and concepts related to the historical deicide charge ('Jews Killed Jesus Christ'), the bible, and rabbinical tradition, demonstrating the model's ability to separate religiously-themed hate speech from other categories of antisemitic discourse like economic or political control conspiracies.
